title: Standalone QA · misaligned pair
narration: An enterprise brief is paired with an SMB-tone plan. The Critic emits coverage / consistency / compliance findings; deterministic governance scanners flag 'Click here', 'Sign up now' as prohibited CTAs and 'world-class', 'seamless', 'revolutionary' as prohibited terms.

top_findings.description: LinkedIn CTA 'Click here' is in the channel's prohibited list.
top_findings.fix: Replace with one of: Book a demo, See how it works, Read the playbook, Talk to sales.

top_findings.description: Plan audience summary targets 'small business owners' while brief specifies enterprise (1000+ employees).
top_findings.fix: Rewrite audience_summary to reflect VP RevOps at 1000+ employee companies.

top_findings.description: Paid Search notes contain prohibited terms: 'seamless', 'revolutionary'.
top_findings.fix: Remove and rewrite with concrete, quantified claims.
